Fight can be accessed by pressing the Underground Button on the terminal in the south central part of Eeza. The password for the Underground Button is obtained on the right side (Amy's path) of the KMS Eastern Division, behind a secret door (indicated with a !) on floor 3. Remembering the password is unnecessary.
